rows.en:
"Even like that, they're alive.
And now they're my comrades.
The only difference is whether you keep a human shape like this or not."
Then he looked at {f:me|me} once more and laughed.
"...Whether you get to keep the shape you've got now probably depends on you.
If you fuse well, let's make more comrades together.
Hee hee hee..."
Then he turned his eyes the opposite way from the living lumps of flesh.{p}

"Hey there, Iwashita.
Looks like you couldn't fuse properly.
But don't worry.
I'll take care of you from here on.
Kuh hee hee hee..."
Hino put his hand over his mouth as if to hold back his laughter.{p}

For an instant, Hino looked blurry.
His face seemed to waver, like ripples on water.
Hino had a nasty grin on his face.
{f:I|I} knew by instinct that he was about to do something to us.
If we just sat still like this, there was no telling what he'd do to us.
...And yet.
Right now I was in the grip of a feeling that I didn't want to think about anything, didn't want to do anything at all.
"Looks like the drug is working nicely on you all.
Heh heh heh, I put a drug in those drinks.
You're all going to merge with us.
Once you join us, each of you will be able to bring out your own talents to the fullest.
As we merge with more and more people, in the end we'll become a single life-form inferior to no one.
Amazing, isn't it?
You should be rejoicing.
And you should be grateful to Mr. Shirai, too, for making this research a success."
Then the dimly wavering Hino held his palm out toward {f:us|us}.{p}

"Hmph, I suppose that Iwayama person took him away, didn't he?
He had it coming, don't you think?"
Iwashita said languidly.
...It was true, Hino might have been taken away.
I shouldn't have turned off the light back then...
Iwashita went on.
"Well, now Hino has told us the seventh story himself, in the flesh.
{a}{f:|}, you're lucky to have a club president who cares so much about his juniors.
You'll be able to make an interesting newspaper. Heh heh."
A cold laugh.
After what had just happened right in front of us, what was she {f:saying|saying}?{p}

Standing there was a man I'd never seen before.
The man said,
"I'm sure you've all figured it out by now.
I'm Iwayama.
From now on, Hino and I are one.
Body and soul together.
But I've got the upper hand over Hino, by a long shot.
Long story short, I've sealed Hino up inside me. Heh heh heh."
With that, Iwayama tore his own face apart down the middle to show us.
Inside was Hino's face, on the verge of tears.
"Get me out of here☆"
Before Hino could even finish saying it, Iwayama stuck his face back together the way it was.
"So, you guys don't need to worry."
With that, Iwayama left the club room.{p}

...And that's the end of my story.
{c}{f:|}.
Meeting you like this can't be a coincidence, can it?
I bet you don't believe it, but Sanae was giving a warning.
You've got some kind of secret, don't you?
Am I wrong?
Well, I don't know what it is.
But you'd better be careful.
I don't really know the details myself.
So, whose story is next?
I can't wait... Hee hee.{p}

Really?
You'd believe a story like this right away...
Huh?
You want to meet Sanae?
{c}{f:|}, {f:are you trying to hit on her|do you mean it}?
Oh well, I'll tell Sanae.
{f:Oh, come on|Next time}, {f:you don't have to make excuses|come over to our class}.
{f:I hope you two end up going out|I'll introduce you}.
Sanae's a little odd, but she's a good girl.
{f:But|Oh}, {f:when you kiss her|I know}, {f:your mouth might feel all squirmy|let's all have lunch together then}.
Hee hee...
That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}
Hee hee, well, {c}{f:|}?{p}Do you believe my story?

Hee hee, but you believed me, didn't you?
So you're fine with me being a vampire.
Good, because I was just getting hungry.
{c}{f:|}, would you treat me to a meal?
I mean blood, of course.
Don't worry, I won't kill you.
You'll get a little sleepy, but that much is okay, right?
See, it was just a little prick, wasn't it?
It didn't hurt, did it?
Are you starting to feel sleepy?
When you wake up, everyone will be one of us.
Oh, but watch out for the morning sun.
You'll turn to ash.
So this is the end of our little gathering, huh?
It had only just started, too. What a shame.{p}

...It's really grotesque to look at, though.
Sanae and I are even closer friends than before.
And she seems to have gotten completely better, too.
When she's in a good mood, you can often hear singing.
Who's singing, you ask...? Isn't it obvious?
Whether you believe this story or not is up to you, {c}{f:|}.
Hee hee, well then, that's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

Really?
Well, I'll take your word for it.
If you believe me, then you can already guess what kind of person appeared, right?
Hee hee, that's right.
Ketsu the idol star was a demon.
I say demon, but he's just a low-ranking one called an incubus, who seduces girls and takes their souls.
He probably became an idol to make his job easier, don't you think?{p}

{f:What should I do|What should I do}...
{f:I|I} hesitated.
{f:But|But} the answer came to me right away.
"Let's continue."
Sure, Fukuzawa's story was juicy.
I {f:think|do think} it's a scoop.
But right now, {f:I|I} have {f:an important job|an important job} to do.
Covering these seven wonders is {f:my|my} first assignment, entrusted to me by Hino{f:.|, after all.}
I can't go chasing scoops before I've even finished a single job.
"Aww, what a letdown.
So you were lying about believing me after all?
I'm not blaming you or anything.
I just wanted to get interviewed too.
But that's so like you, {c}{f:|}.
I thought about pitching it to a TV station or something myself.
But it felt too much like selling out a friend, so I didn't.
Hee hee, sorry.
That was a bit of a sneaky idea, huh?
Well then, I'll end my story about here...
Who's next?"{p}

"Please, take me to the drinking fountain."
Miyagi's voice was more desperate than before.
Even Sugiura seemed a little surprised.
Hee hee hee, {b}?{p}What would you have answered?

Hee hee hee, what's wrong?
Are you scared?
Ha ha ha, relax.
They don't take water from that reservoir anymore.
A big dam got built a while back, remember?
Though there's no guarantee nobody's died there.
Yeah, the water source changed, so maybe no more muddy water.
Maybe I'll go unseal that faucet later.
Don't tell anyone else, okay?
Hee hee hee.
That's the end of my story.
...Who's next?{p}

You know, I have an idea who that girl is.
Who? Sugiura, the one who transferred, of course.
Hee hee hee, officially it was a transfer, but actually, she'd killed herself, apparently.
Maybe her guilty conscience was tormenting her...
She was more timid than she looked, huh?{p}

Hee hee hee, my mom graduated from here.
She was Sugiura's classmate.
And while I'm at it, my big sister graduated from here too.
And the one who saw Sugiura burning and called it in was my dad.
They got together because of what happened with Miyagi and Sugiura...
You can't call it romantic, but they're a pretty unusual couple, huh?
These days the rumor's almost forgotten, but that faucet's still sealed.
Phew, that's as far as my story goes.
Who are you picking next?{p}

I mean, it's creepy, after all.
A faucet that makes ghost voices... right?
Hee hee hee...
That's the end of my story.
Now, whose turn is it next?{p}

Oh, sorry.
That story's going to make tap water even harder to drink, huh.
Hee hee hee...
That's the end of my story.
Now, whose turn is it next?{p}

Who knows? How would I know that?
Why don't you sneak over later and take the seal off the faucet?
Do you have the guts to try?
Hee hee hee.
That's the end of my story.
Now, whose turn is it next?{p}

Oh!
You said you like them.
Hee hee hee... Don't blame me for what happens to you later.
So, {c}{f:|}?
What about cherry blossoms in particular?{p}I bet you just love cherry blossoms.

Hee hee, you're just putting on a brave face.
But take responsibility for what you said, okay?
I'm scared, so I'm going back to the club room.
You can look at the tree as long as you like, {c}{f:|}.
See you later, then.{p}If you take too long, I'll go home without you.

Hee hee, looks like you did see something, {c}{f:|}.
If you didn't see anything, I guess that means your sixth sense is weak.
...You've had enough now, right?
Let's go back to the club room.
We still have to hear everyone else's stories.
Who are you picking next?{p}

{c}{f:|}, you saw the spirits, didn't you?
Hee hee, I didn't see a thing.
But you saw them, right?
Ever since I heard this story, I've brought all kinds of people here, but you're the first one who's ever seen the spirits, {c}{f:|}.
So I don't know what happens to people who get bewitched.
Sorry.
You'll probably get dragged in.
Scary, huh.
...I see, so the rumor was true.
Well, I'm satisfied now, so shall we head back to the club room?
Hee hee, don't worry.
If anything happens to you, {c}{f:|}, I'll prove it for you.
It was the cherry tree's curse.
...Like that.
That's as far as my story goes.
Who's next...?{p}

{c}{f:|}?
You look pale.
Don't tell me you're seeing something horrible?
Oh my, that's bad.
We'd better hurry back to the club room.
Hee hee, but it's the same wherever you go, I guess...
Anyway, my story ends here.
Next person, go ahead.{p}

There'll be a tiny baby in there.
And it'll cling to your legs.
Hee hee... Earning {f:a girl's|my} grudge is a scary thing, you know.
{c}{f:|}, you must be looking forward to bedtime.
It's going to happen soon, I promise.
...Well then, let's hear the next person's story.
Okay?{p}

I know how.
You know those tear-off calendars, right?
You set one to Friday the 13th.
And then you hang it on the wall by the thirteen steps from the rumor.
Then they say the same thing happens.
But I guess that way, the effect is weaker after all.
They say unless you've got a really strong sixth sense, the stairs won't turn into thirteen steps.
But if they did, that'd be awful too, right?
"Yay!
It's thirteen steps!"
Even if you said that, in the end nothing but bad things would happen.
But still, it's interesting, isn't it?
Don't rumors like that make you really want to try them?
Hee hee...
I went and tried it.{p}

{c}{f:|}.
Next time, why don't you count the stairs in your own house as you go up?
You might discover something new, you know?
Hee hee...
Okay, let's hear the next story.
I wonder what kind of story it'll be this time...?{p}

{c}{f:|}.
When you find someone you really love, why not {f:try giving them a ruby ring|try binding them with something}?
If your feelings are as strong as his, {f:you might manage a binding of bloody tears|you just might manage it}.
Hee hee...
Okay, let's hear the next story.
Oh right, if you want to hear that thirteen steps story I mentioned earlier, go take a look at the old school building first.
Okay?
So who's going to tell the next story?{p}

Hee hee hee, that's right.
When you find someone you really love, you'd better give them something.
It doesn't have to be a ring.
And then you say,
"{f:My|My} feelings won't change."
Just like that.
Hee hee hee, good luck.
Okay, let's go on to the next story.
The thirteen steps story will have to wait for another time.
...So, who's next?{p}

But you know, {c}{f:|}.
From now on, be careful when you go on dates in the old school building.
That tear-off calendar is still hanging on that staircase.
Whatever happens, don't blame me.
Hee hee hee, that's the end of my story.
Come on, let's hurry on to the next one.{p}

"Hee hee hee, sorry.
I was lying to you.
The story about the thirteen steps in the old school building was a lie.
I don't have any friends who'd hang around with me."
"But why★
Was the whole story a lie{f:, then|, then}?"
"Not all of it.
The story about the girl who killed herself is true.
Because that girl is me!"{p}

They say neither of them can live long while the soul stays split, so maybe it turned out for the best.
Hee hee hee, so how was my story?
Looks like your head's all jumbled up.
But I don't want to talk about it anymore.
I'm about to get confused myself.
Come on, let's hurry on to the next one.{p}

Hee hee, I knew it.
Mr. Miyama suddenly felt ashamed of how he'd been acting, too.
Once he calmed down and thought it over rationally, he regretted that ever since he'd confiscated the ring, he'd behaved in a way no adult ever should.
And what came back to him was the man he'd been when he'd had nothing but pure feelings for Ishikawa.
Why hadn't he treated her with the feelings he'd had back then?
He'd been treating a girl in the middle of adolescence the wrong way.
...He wasn't a bad teacher at heart, I guess.
The teacher decided this confession should be made to Ishikawa herself, so he took that ruby ring and headed for her house.{p}

Hee hee hee, you be careful too, {c}{f:|}.
Even if you don't mean to, there's no telling when or where you might be pouring a curse into something.
Did you trip over an empty can this morning?
Did you bang your head on the corner of a desk?
What did you think when that happened?
If you think anything too terrible...
...Well then, that's the end of my story.
Who are you picking next...?{p}

Hee hee hee, nobody can ever know the real truth, right?
That's where my story ends.
I'll tell you the thirteen-steps story another day, so go and see it for yourself first.
Then I'll tell you all about it.
Who's next...?{p}

You want to think about it?
Ahahaha.
{c}{f:|}, are you getting flustered?
I know, what you said a minute ago was a joke, right?
It wasn't very funny.
I was asking you seriously and you answered with a lame joke, so I was just paying you back. I may not look it, but I'm actually a good swimmer.
I even went to swimming school.
But the way I swim isn't the competition kind, all about times and form.
I learned emergency swimming, like putting clothes on and taking them off underwater, or swimming with your shoes still on.
It's about how to save yourself with whatever's around you, like when a ship sinks or you fall into the sea.
You're laughing, {c}{f:|}, but swimming in your clothes takes a lot of stamina.
One T-shirt is no trouble at all, but emergencies happen in sweatshirt and sweater season too, you know.
If you don't practice properly, you'll drown under the weight of your own clothes.
...Hee hee, looks like you get it now.{p}

Hee hee hee.
Your class has swimming in P.E. tomorrow, right, {c}{f:|}?
Whatever you do, don't swim in Lane 4.
Though if you're reeeally confident, I won't stop you.
Well, that's the end of my story.
If the seventh one doesn't show up, the next person will be the last, huh.{p}

Hee hee hee, P.E. is going to be a lot more fun from now on.
Your class has swimming tomorrow, as it happens, doesn't it, {c}{f:|}?
Don't you dare skip it.
...Just kidding.
Well, that's as far as my story goes.
I wonder what happened to the seventh one?
If they don't come, the next person is the last, huh.{p}

...Hee hee hee.
Your class is cleaning the pool for P.E. tomorrow, right, {c}{f:|}?
Sneak into Lane 4 and see.
Don't worry, there's no water in it, and you won't be swimming, so nothing's going to happen.
...Well, at most, everyone might stare at you, {c}{f:|}.
That won't make you feel any pressure, will it?
What counts is staying relaxed.
That's the end of my story, but... the seventh one still isn't here, huh.
I guess the next person will be the last...{p}

Oh, come on.
You're actually curious, aren't you?
Hee hee, I'll take you there, just this once.
Let's go see.
Whether the cursed locker really exists.{p}

"Just kidding.
Hee hee, did I scare you?
That's payback for scaring me earlier."
Fukuzawa giggled merrily.
...
{f:Geez|Honestly}.
She's {f:exhausting|exhausting}.
{f:I just want to get this over with|I want this whole thing over with}.{p}

Ooh, so personality comes first.
So you don't care at all what their face looks like, huh.
Heh heh... just kidding, just kidding.{p}Okay, so what comes next?

Oh, I know☆
{a}, you should go and be one of Hirai's customers.
My big sister knows which hospital Hirai's in, so it's no problem.
Okay, sometime... let's see, let's go together over summer vacation or something.
If you think of it as helping someone, you won't be scared.
Oh, right.
You think it's nothing but a nasty prank, don't you, {a}?
Then you won't be scared at all, will you?
It's decided. It's a promise.
Want to pinky swear?
Hee hee hee.
Well, that's the end of my story.
The seventh one never showed up after all.
What are you going to do?{p}

Hee hee hee, {a}.
You get it now, right?
If Hirai had kept on going to that fortune-teller, she might have been eaten up by the wicked witch.
Fortune-telling isn't something you should get too wrapped up in.
Okay, that's the end of my story.
The seventh one isn't coming, so what are you going to do, {a}...?{p}

Hee hee hee, you've got a 'how come?' look on your face.
You think it's weird that I know who did it?
My big sister had a crush on Hirai's brother, you see.
And while she was always watching him, she happened to see him push Suzuki down.
He was the guy she admired, so she didn't tell anyone and kept it a secret.
That's why nobody noticed what he was doing, not Suzuki, and not even his own sister, Hirai.{p}

You'd better be careful too, {a}.
Most girls love fortune-telling, after all.
Hee hee hee.
I guess I'll end my story about here...
So what will you do? The seventh one still isn't here.
Right, {a}?{p}

"Me?
Heh heh... You're saying I'll be killed?
If anyone like that exists, I'll kill them first, before I ever die.
Instead of worrying about other people, you should worry about yourself."
Iwashita's face was smiling, but her eyes were terribly cold.{p}

"Grandma just told me.
If we offer one of the people here to him as a sacrifice, everyone else can be saved."
A murmur ran through everyone.
"But don't worry, everyone.
I'll decide...
Hey, {a}, how about you?
Hee hee hee."{p}
...Heh heh, let's just say I'm an extraterrestrial life-form. A good man ought to keep plenty of mystery about him, after all.){p}

Before long, a bitter, frustrated groan resounded through the club room, and at the same moment, Kanda's body vanished.
Only Hosoda's head remained, floating in the air.
Then once again, Hosoda's voice came into my head.
(What a nasty person.
He hasn't changed one bit, even after dying.
Getting killed by me twice... Heh heh heh, poor thing.){p}

"{a}, you really are a fool, aren't you?
You had the chance to borrow the power of the legendary hunter, the Bohheritian.
And now, with that one word of yours, this Earth has been abandoned.
So {f:we|we} will go ahead and invade Earth without holding back.
Heh heh heh..."{p}

"What's wrong? ...Were you going to check whether anyone's outside? It's fine. There's no one there. Heh heh, just send out an ultrasonic pulse and you'd know in a second, wouldn't you?"
What {f:is|is} this guy talking about?
What do I do?
This is getting worse and worse...{p}

That girl was me.
...Ah.
Akemi Iwashita just killed herself.
Heh heh heh... Serves her right.
She slit her own throat with a box cutter in her own room.
...What a stupid woman.
She killed herself because she was tormented by an evil spirit that doesn't even exist.
...Oh, but maybe I'm the evil spirit.
Hee hee... But you know, I can't pass on unless I get my revenge.
...Do you understand now?
The six who told you scary stories are the children of the six who drove me to suicide.
When I killed myself, my father and mother were heartbroken.
But neither those six nor their parents did anything for us.
They said their children weren't the ones to blame.
You see, the six from back then have grown up and become parents like anyone else.
It's no coincidence that their children all ended up coming to this school together.
It's fate.
They were fated from the very start to be killed by me.
You just happened to serve as their guide along the way.
...All six of them are dead.
Those brats' parents... the six who drove me to my death, will surely grieve.
Just as my father and mother grieved.
{a}.
Do you think what I did was horrible?
Do you think their children weren't to blame?{p}

...Well, never mind.
None of that matters anymore...
After that, I found no salvation, and I wandered the school.
And then I realized.
There were many children in the same situation as me...
Children like that couldn't pass on, and they wandered around just like me.
Not only spirits of the dead, but living spirits too.
Before we knew it, we had started gathering together.
Heh heh heh.
It's funny, isn't it? I guess that's what they mean by "birds of a feather flock together."
"★"
Just then, something peeked out from behind her.
...A girl?{p}

Before I knew it, I was surrounded by the masked children.
...Didn't I tell you at the very beginning that I can see right through what you're thinking?
Heh heh heh, in the end you're no different from anyone else.
And I thought you, at least, would understand us.
If you had, maybe this time we really could have been saved...
From this world that is neither the human world nor the spirit world.
I'm sure we'll keep repeating the same mistakes, even knowing they're wrong.
...As long as we're in this world.
Little by little, the masked children drew closer to me.
The ring around me grew tighter and tighter.
One step, then another, and then another...
Maybe I could have saved them.
I could have stopped them.
Was there nothing left for me now but to surrender myself to them...?
And then she spoke to me.
...I'm sure we'll keep repeating the same mistakes, even knowing they're wrong.{p}

...I didn't lay a hand on the ones who drove me to my death.
Instead, I thought I'd be saved by driving their children to their deaths.
I felt that doing so would wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?
...Do you think I'm cruel?
Heh heh heh, think whatever you like.
...But remember this much.
When you commit a sin, you won't necessarily be the one who pays for it.
Through something you'd never expect, someone may be made to atone for the sin you committed.
And when that happens, it'll be too late for regrets.
But it doesn't matter anymore.
None of it...
I've achieved my goal, but I don't think I need to be saved anymore.
...I never thought that even in this state, a heart just like a human's would grow in me.
Just as those children came to enjoy bullying.
And just as it became a habit for them.
I've come to enjoy plunging people into the depths of terror.
Yes, you can find pleasure in anything at all.
It's a real problem, isn't it?
So I've decided to go on like this, chasing nothing but my own pleasure in this school.
Don't worry.
I won't do anything to you.
You're a good person.
I can tell...{p}

(Heh heh heh, we've finally caught up with you.)
(Come on, {a}. Come with us.)
When I looked up, I saw what seemed to be Shindo and Iwashita standing right in front of me.
Both of them were wearing masks over their faces.{p}

...I didn't lay a hand on the ones who drove me to my death.
Instead, I thought I'd be saved by driving their children to their deaths.
I felt that doing so would wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?
...Do you think I'm cruel?
Heh heh heh, think whatever you like.
...But remember this much.
When you commit a sin, you won't necessarily be the one who pays for it.
Through something you'd never expect, someone may be made to atone for the sin you committed.
And when that happens, it'll be too late for regrets.
But it doesn't matter anymore.
None of it...
I've achieved my goal, but I don't think I need to be saved anymore.
...I never thought that even in this state, a heart just like a human's would grow in me.
Just as those children came to enjoy bullying.
And just as it became a habit for them.
I've come to enjoy plunging people into the depths of terror.
Yes, you can find pleasure in anything at all.
It's a real problem, isn't it?
So I've decided to go on like this, chasing nothing but my own pleasure in this school.
Don't worry.
I won't do anything to you.
You're a good person.
I can tell...{p}

I didn't know what to say.
But revenge was wrong.
I understood how she felt, too.
But they hadn't had anything to do with it directly, had they?
That was what I thought.
"Heh heh heh heh... I told you at the start, didn't I?
That I know what you're thinking.
Yes.
That's right.
They had nothing to do with it.
The ones to blame are their parents, not them.
But my revenge is over.
It's too late.
By killing their children, I'm giving them a taste of the grief my parents went through.{p}So, do you think this has saved me?"

".........Pfft... Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"
I burst out laughing so hard my sides nearly split.
What was so funny about a gag like that?
But I couldn't stop laughing.
It was humiliating.
To think I'd laugh at a gag like that.
I laughed so hard my diaphragm started to ache.
Tears streamed endlessly from my eyes.
I-I can't... breathe...
I was laughing so violently I couldn't breathe, and it grew more and more painful.
Drool dribbled sloppily from my mouth.
I tried to draw a breath, but it wouldn't come.
"...Hee... hee-hee..."
He said I'd die having fun, but... it... hurts... so...{p}

Very well. Then I'll go on ahead. I'll be looking forward to it, so come soon.
Heh heh heh heh heh...){p}
...Hee hee.{p}
Hee hee...{p}

By the time I tried to ask him again, the six of them had vanished.
And then I realized.
Before I knew it, I was floating in a pitch-black void.
What is this★
I was supposed to be in my own room.
As far as I could see, there was nothing.
An absolute darkness that seemed to swallow even light.
Where am I?
Why am I in a place like this★
"Somebody...!"
I tried shouting, and a chill ran through me.
It felt as if my voice was being sucked into infinite space.
"Heh heh heh... What are you making such a fuss about?"
A woman's voice spoke inside my head.
"You were the one who refused to come to us... who wished to wake from the dream..."
